title: a JSON number literal out of f64 range (1e400) makes the port reject the whole request line (reply has id null)
right_side: legacy (Python json.loads gives inf and the op runs; str(inf) is written)
severity: wrong response (validation error instead of op result); the reply carries id:null so an id-matching client waits forever
culprit: rpc.rs handle_line (serde_json::from_str fails with 'number out of range')
suggested_fix: low priority; at minimum echo the request id (parse {id} leniently) so clients do not hang; optionally accept out-of-range numbers as inf
